import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size

    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    tile = nl.ndarray((C, 128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    tile_view = tile.ap([[1, C], [p, H // p], [p, W // p]])
    sum_tile = nl.ndarray((C, H // p, W // p), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.psum)
    nl.sum(tile_view, axis=[2, 4], dst=sum_tile)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=sum_tile, data=1.0 / (p * p), op0=nisa.multiply)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sum_tile)
    return out
